title: Scaffold react_ui project with Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind
description:
Create the react_ui/ project scaffold for a React chat UI.

Create package.json with dependencies: react, react-dom, @types/react, @types/react-dom, typescript, vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer. Include scripts for dev (vite), build (tsc && vite build), preview (vite preview).

Configure vite.config.ts with the React plugin and a proxy for /api to http://localhost:8000 for development.

Configure tsconfig.json with strict mode, JSX react-jsx, target ES2020, module ESNext, moduleResolution bundler, paths for src/*.

Configure tailwind.config.js with content paths for ./index.html and ./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}, enable darkMode: 'class', and extend the theme with dark background and text colors.

Configure postcss.config.js with tailwindcss and autoprefixer plugins.

Create index.html with a root div and module script entry to /src/main.tsx.

Create src/main.tsx that renders a placeholder <div> into the root element with 'loading' text.

Create src/index.css with @tailwind base, components, utilities directives and a minimal dark theme: body background #111827, text #e5e7eb, font-family system-ui.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: react_ui/package.json exists with react, vite, typescript, tailwindcss dependencies
react_ui/vite.config.ts exists with React plugin and /api proxy
react_ui/tsconfig.json exists with strict mode and JSX support
react_ui/tailwind.config.js exists with dark mode and src content paths
react_ui/postcss.config.js exists with tailwindcss and autoprefixer plugins
react_ui/index.html exists with root div and module script entry
react_ui/src/main.tsx exists and renders a React root
react_ui/src/index.css exists with Tailwind directives and dark theme base styles
cd react_ui && npm install succeeds with exit code 0
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add new third-party dependencies beyond react, react-dom, vite, typescript, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer
